guidance_for_2018: Management expects the Passenger Car market to hit volumes of 120,000 units, of which GB Auto's market share is set to be at least 30% in 2018
Automotive Directive legislation expected finalized before end of 2018
Motorcycles & Three-Wheelers: two-wheeler chassis manufacturing begun 2017, expected to boost volumes in 2018
Tires: distributing Turkish-made tuk-tuk tires from 1Q18; commercialize Pirelli and Pharos truck tires from February 2018
guidance subject to change in light of fluctuating regional geopolitical and macroeconomic conditions
notes: FY17 disclosure re-cut: core automotive reported as 'GB Auto & Auto Related' separate from GB Capital (adopted 2Q17)
Iraq PC revenue up ~3x y-o-y FY17; GP LE 27.6mn vs 11.4mn FY16
GB Polo stake raised to 80% from 51% at end-2017
PC market includes Hyundai/Geely/Mazda/Chery for GB; Hyundai #1 at 21.9% share FY17
